name: Godwin Edgar Opuka
summary: Financial Engineer, Full-Stack Developer and Solutions Architect with end-to-end ownership of production-grade platforms across fintech, AI, and enterprise software. Currently building Afripay, a Stellar-powered borderless remittance platform, and leading DevOps at Zamadi Group. Proficient in developing scalable financial systems and automating fiscal processes for high enterprise value.

experience.title: Full-Stack Developer & DevOps Lead
bullets: Architected and built a full-stack payment platform supporting cross-border remittance across 8+ African currencies using the Stellar Network for settlement.
Engineered an immutable double-entry ledger system ensuring idempotent accounting, and built a 3-tier KYC/AML verification via Onfido API.
Delivered a React 19 admin workspace for real-time monitoring and a Flutter mobile app for cross-platform wallet management.
Built a full Learning Management System (Virtual Campus) for tertiary organizations like NYS Kenya using React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.
Sole owner of CI/CD pipelines, Docker containerization, infrastructure provisioning, and deployment management across all products.

experience.title: Solutions Architect & BI Lead
bullets: Architecting the Twin Graph Manager, a graph-powered digital business platform modeling enterprise digital twins via Neo4j and graph data science.
Designing a full-stack MACH-aligned platform with a Neo4j backend, GraphQL/REST API layer, and React component-driven frontend.
Overseeing enterprise architecture modeling using Ardoq and Abacus, and directing AI agent deployment for business process automation.
Managing sprint planning and resolving blockers for a team of 9 analysts to ensure timely delivery.

experience.title: BI Developer and AI Dev
bullets: Engineered end-to-end data pipelines using Python, R, Spark, and Microsoft Fabric, and built CI/CD on Azure DevOps.
Deployed ML-powered REST/GraphQL services and developed dashboards using PowerBI and DAX.
Built data infrastructure for Microsoft Native environments using Microsoft GraphAPI and Data Lakehouse architectures.

experience.title: Data Analyst
bullets: Delivered quantitative analytical solutions across finance and business domains, including financial statement and ratio analysis.
Conducted econometrics analyses, hypothesis testing, and advanced data modeling using R, Python, and Stata.
Performed qualitative data analysis and descriptive/diagnostic analytics using SPSS and Excel (Macros, PivotTables).
